units.source_text: 就是在告别赛的对局中，名人一次也不曾说过这类应酬的话。

en.t: Even during the farewell match, the Master never once said this kind of polite, conventional thing.

units.source_text: 所有寒暄都是由夫人出面。

en.t: All the greetings and courtesies were handled by his wife.

units.source_text: 他从不以名人自居，仗势欺人。

en.t: He never acted as though his rank as Master entitled him to put on airs or bully others with his prestige.
That was the kind of person he was.
